parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS7A0233PDBVR supplies up to 200 mA (p.5) compared to TPS7A2033PDBVR at 300 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (TPS7A0233PDBVR: 270 mV p.6 vs TPS7A2033PDBVR: 145 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.
engineering_verdict: TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A2033PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Iout,max rating drops >=20%; dropout voltage headroom differs (125 mV / 1.9x). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 46.4 °C on TPS7A0233PDBVR (θJA 181.9 °C/W) vs 47.7 °C on TPS7A2033PDBVR (θJA 187.1 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 260x ratio (0.025 µA (p.6) vs 6.5 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS7A0233PDBVR "Strict 22 uF Maximum Output Capacitance Limit for Loop Stability" (p.5) and TPS7A2033PDBVR "Output Capacitor ESR Must Stay <= 100 mOhm (Avoid Tantalum/Electrolytic Caps)" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TPS7A0233PDBVR when battery sleep budget demands 0.025 µA Iq; choose TPS7A2033PDBVR when load current exceeds 200 mA (up to 300 mA) or low Vin-Vout headroom requires 145 mV dropout. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
